describe: Desktop light onboarding 'goals' screen. Left column: logo lockup, Back pill, headline 'What should we grow first?', subtitle, and a stack of six selectable goal cards each with a 3D icon, title, benefit text and radio. Top centre: a step-pill progress row with a round '7' badge; top right: an English language chip. Right half: a futuristic pastel sci-fi cityscape with domes and a ringed planet, a glowing circular floor platform, a cartoon boy in a blue jacket pointing upward standing beside white-and-blue robot Nova, five circular goal-node badges with labels (graduation cap, star, trophy, book, planet) wired together by thin glowing connector lines that converge on a bright point near the boy's fingertip, a small speech bubble to the right of the robot, and a wide CONTINUE button near the bottom. No bottom navigation dock on this screen.
